Necromancy  Upgrade Order, Talent Tree & Ability Bars
Introduction
This channel lists the general natural combat style progression template for new players to follow devised by the RuneScape Discord Luminaries in collaboration with PVME. From levels 1 - 20, where an item is marked P2P, this means it is a members item.
Last Revised: 11 June 2024
​
All bars assume Revo++ is being used. The bars below are taken from the Youtube video: Necromancy revolution bars. Below we use the AoE Healing bars as our main AoE bar whilst you learn combat in RuneScape. It is worth noting that Necromancy ability bars can change upon every new ability unlock. Therefore, for more granular information on how to set up your ability bars at each ability unlock, check out the linked video above.
Talent Tree Unlocks

Talents allow the player to unlock and upgrade Necromancy abilities, incantations, and passive effects. Talents can be unlocked with talent points, which can be acquired by gaining experience in combat using necromancy as a combat style. Unlocking higher tiers requires a combination of Necromancy levels, an amount of souls contributed to the Well of Souls through rituals, at least one talent from the previous tier, as well as the completion of quests and are managed at the Well of Souls at the ritual site in the City of Um.
​
We recommend you upgrade your talent tree in the following order:

⬥ Unlock  as soon as possible over any unbought upgrades when you hit level 70
Levels 1 - 20 
You must craft weapons and armour at least once to be able to equip them (excluding the tier 10 set)
Gear:
⬥ 1 ‎ ‎ Death guard (tier 10) & Skull lantern (tier 10)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Free from the quest Necromancy!
⬥ 20  Death guard (tier 20) & Skull lantern (tier 20)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the quest Kili Row
Armour
​
⬥ 1 ‎ ‎ Deathwarden robe armour (tier 10)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bought from Buried Bargains after completion of the quest Necromancy!
⬥ 20  Deathwarden robe armour (tier 20)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the quest Kili Row
⬥ Amulet of power
⬥ Deathstorm drape - Best in Slot cape for F2P
⬥ Silverhawk boots (non-ironman & P2P) can be freely claimed from the Marketplace and give a small damage boost.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The boots can be upgraded at lvl 20, 40, 50 and 60  respectively.
Rituals
To unlock Talents in tier 2 of the Talent Tree at level 20, the player will need 50 souls. To maximise souls per ritual, you can use a Fragile memento performing Lesser communication rituals. These are 8 souls per ritual before accounting for multiply glyphs.

⬥ 1 - 20  Ghostly Troll Thrower in City of Um cave.
⬥ 1 - 20  Monsters in Lumbridge Catacombs. Requires Blood Pact quest.
Levels 20 - 50 
You must craft weapons and armour at least once to be able to equip them
Useful quests:
⬥ 24  Complete the quest Rune Mythos
⬥ 46  Complete the quest Vessel of the Harbinger
Gear:
⬥ 30 ‎ ‎ Death guard (tier 30) & Skull lantern (tier 30)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the achievement Kili's Knowledge I
⬥ 40 ‎ ‎ Death guard (tier 40) & Skull lantern (tier 40)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the achievement Kili's Knowledge II
⬥ 50 ‎ ‎ Death guard (tier 50) & Skull lantern (tier 50)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the achievement Kili's Knowledge III

Armour
​
⬥ 30 ‎ ‎ Deathwarden robe armour (tier 30)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the achievement Kili's Knowledge I
⬥ 40 ‎ ‎ Deathwarden robe armour (tier 40)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the achievement Kili's Knowledge II
⬥ 50 ‎ ‎ Deathwarden robe armour (tier 50)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the achievement Kili's Knowledge III
⬥ Obsidian cape or Cape of legends
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Latter requires completion of the quest Legends Quest
⬥  Salve amulet (e) - for combat with undead creatures
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the quest Haunted Mine and the miniquest Lair of Tarn Razorlor
⬥ Amulet of glory - for combat with non-undead creatures
⬥ Ring of Wealth
⬥ Tome of Um 2 (P2P)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tome of Um requires completion of the medium City of Um achievements
Rituals
To unlock Talents in tier 3 of the Talent Tree at level 40, the player will need 400 souls. To maximise souls per ritual, you can use a Fragile memento performing Lesser communication rituals. These are 8 souls per ritual before accounting for multiply glyphs.
Ability bars levels 20 - 50 
​
Bar at 20 

⬥ At level 28  you unlock  but don't add it to your bar just yet
⬥ At level 36  you unlock  - an AoE ability that can heal you from surrounding targets. Add this to the front of your AoE bar
⬥ At level 40  you unlock  and  if you have unlocked them at the talent tree.
⬥ At level 48  you unlock  - a damage over time ability. Add this to the end of your Single Target and AoE bars.

⬥ 20 - 30  Monsters in Lumbridge Catacombs. Requires Blood Pact quest.

⬥ 30 - 40  Ghosts in any of their locations.
⬥ 40 - 50  Banshees in the Slayer Tower
Levels 50 - 70 
You must craft weapons and armour at least once to be able to equip them
Useful quests:
⬥ 65  Complete the quest The Spirit of War
Gear:
⬥ 60 ‎ ‎ Death guard (tier 60) & Skull lantern (tier 60)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the achievement Kili's Knowledge IV
​
After reaching 60  and finishing the above, refer to #unknown-channel for weapon advice
​
Armour
⬥ 60 ‎ ‎ Deathwarden robe armour (tier 60)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the achievement Kili's Knowledge IV
⬥ Cape of legends
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the quest Legends Quest
⬥ Ring of Fortune
⬥ One of the God books      
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the quest Horror from the Deep
​
After reaching 60  and finishing the above, refer to #unknown-channel for armour advice
Rituals
To unlock Talents in tiers 4 and 5 of the Talent Tree at levels 60 and 70 respectively, the player will need 2,000 souls for tier 4 and 4,500 souls for tier 5. To maximise souls per ritual, wait until 60  to begin performing rituals again. You can use a Spirit memento performing Greater communication rituals. These are 24 souls per ritual before accounting for multiply glyphs.
Ability bars levels 50 - 70

Bars at 50

AoE

​
⬥ At level 60  you will unlock the ability to command your ghost conjure using  if you have unlocked it at the talent tree. This ability overrides  whilst your ghost is summoned and increases the damage you deal to your target.
​
⬥ At level 60  you will unlock the ability to command your zombie conjure using  if you have unlocked it at the talent tree. This ability overrides  whilst your zombie is summoned and is a strong AoE ability.
​
⬥ At level 62  you unlock  from the talent tree and add this to your AoE bar.
⬥ At level 66  you unlock  and add this to your Single Target bar.
⬥ At level 66  add  to your AoE bar.
⬥ At level 70  you unlock  from the talent tree - this will override  without you needing to change anything.
​
At level 70  your bars will look like the bars below:
​
Single Target

AoE

Monsters to kill 50 - 70 
⬥ 50 - 60  Ankous in the Stronghold of Security 4th level.
⬥ 60 - 70  Shadow warriors in the basement of the Legends Guild
⬥ 50 - 70  The Abyss Monsters (req. Enter the Abyss miniquest).
⬥ 60 - 70  Armoured Zombies (req. Defender of Varrock quest,  works!).
Frequently asked questions
⬥ Why are there only Dual Wield weapons listed here?
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Necromancy  currently only has Dual Wield weapons. This guide will be updated should this change in the future.
⬥ What are Special Attacks  and how do I use them?
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Certain weapons e.g.  have special attacks - these are powerful abilities that you have to activate manually. Therefore, place  outside your revolution bar (the abilities with gold trim around them) if your weapon has one. You can find the ability in your Constitution  abilities.
⬥ Can I just train slayer?
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You certainly can if you want some variety. It is, however, slower to train at lower combat levels.
⬥ Why are weapons upgrades more important than armour upgrades? / Why is power armour recommended over tank armour?
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frankly put: You gain more from hitting harder than from getting hit less. A higher tier weapon lets you hit harder by increasing hit chance and damage bonus. Power armour increases damage bonus too. This lets you hit harder and kill more monsters, which means more xp gained per hour.
